description: How guns reach the world: who carries them, how often a dead enemy drops one, and what the on-screen debug messages do.

columns.arm_chance: percent of hostile humanoids that get a gun and ammo and use it
columns.drop_chance: percent of other dead hostile humanoids that drop a gun
columns.good_level: actors at or above this level draw from the better gun list
columns.arm_per_scan: most enemies armed per scan (spreads the work out)
columns.scan_radius: how far from the player (game units) the script looks for enemies and guns
columns.verbose: 1 = show a message when a gun is handed out, dropped or a beam appears
